description:
Use this when the user wants to change a draft post, or schedule it: "shorten the caption", "move it to
Friday 6pm", "set the YouTube title", "schedule it". schedule=true schedules it (YouTube Shorts and TikTok):
only after the user saw this exact post and said yes, and only with the publish permission. Set only what was
asked; the TikTok choices stay off until the user says. The answer lists what platforms would still refuse.
Not for: scheduled or posted posts (refused), new drafts (draft_post), covers (set_post_cover) or removing a
draft (delete_draft). Free. Without schedule=true it stays a draft.

account_id.description: Account to post from, from list_social_accounts.

aigc.description: TikTok: label the video as made with AI.

alt.description: Bluesky: alt text describing the video.

audio_name.description: Instagram: name shown for the audio.

brand_content.description: TikTok: with disclose, a paid partnership.

brand_organic.description: TikTok: with disclose, promotes the user's own brand.

clear.description: Remove any of: title, category, playlist, tags, first_comment, collaborators, audio_name, alt.

disclose.description: TikTok: true marks a brand post; then set brand_organic or brand_content.

first_comment.description: Instagram or Facebook: text of the first comment.

made_for_kids.description: YouTube: made for kids. Needed to schedule.

mode.description: TikTok: "direct" posts to the profile, "inbox" sends to the TikTok inbox.

new_playlist.description: YouTube: name of a playlist to create. Not with playlist_id.

platform.description: Move to: tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook, threads or bluesky.

playlist_id.description: YouTube: existing playlist id, from list_youtube_playlists.

post_id.description: Draft id, from get_post_stats with status "draft".

post_preset.description: Saved preset name or id, from list_post_presets; other fields win over it.

privacy.description: TikTok: public, followers, friends or private. YouTube: public, unlisted or private.

reply_control.description: Threads or Bluesky: who can reply, e.g. everyone.

schedule.description: True schedules it (YouTube Shorts, TikTok), only after the user approved it.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-11-23T18:00:00-05:00; at least a minute ahead.

share_to_feed.description: Instagram: also show in the profile feed.

synthetic.description: YouTube: declare altered or synthetic content.

tags.description: YouTube tags, one word or phrase each.

name: update_draft
title: Update a draft
